LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_TransmuteAdamantine.descript: Within a 7×7 starlight chalk ring around a third-tier altar, fuse elven steel and plasteel under heavy mana pressure into cold, dense adamantine. Output is fixed; higher ritual strength speeds up the transmutation.
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_TransmuteAdamantine.label: rite of adamantine
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_TransmuteElvenSteel.descript: Using a second-tier or higher altar and a 5×5 emerald chalk ring, infuse steel with the resilience of livingwood to transmute pale blue-silver elven steel. Output is fixed; higher ritual strength speeds up the transmutation.
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_TransmuteElvenSteel.label: rite of elven steel
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_TransmuteLivingWood.descript: Within a 3×3 chalk ring around a first-tier or higher altar, use herbal medicine as a catalyst to awaken the vitality inside timber, transmuting it into supple, warm-to-the-touch livingwood. Output is fixed; higher ritual strength speeds up the transmutation.
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_TransmuteLivingWood.label: rite of livingwood
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_TransmuteMithril.description: Within a 7×7 starlight chalk ring around a third-tier altar, smelt elven steel and silver into light, mana-attuned moon-white mithril. Output is fixed; higher ritual strength speeds up the refinement.
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_TransmuteMithril.label: rite of mithril
